name: shipyard
description: Claude Code plugins for building and running fleets of autonomous coding agents — planning work they can finish unsupervised, dispatching them, and landing the result.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Plan, dispatch and land work across a fleet of autonomous Claude Code agents. /fleet:planner turns an idea, spec or messy board into a dispatchable work package; /fleet:coordinator runs the fleet from pre-dispatch gate to clean shutdown. Ships /fleet:open-pr, /fleet:review-pr and three adversarial reviewer agents.
